label: Twelve of seventeen archived recommendations are present in the current hub (ladder in the always-loaded doc, review-status canary, ceiling convention and downgrade evidence, needed-ness prompt, Replacement field, Iron Law relocation, stack-folders validator, review-depth alias, agent mirror gate, anti-stall rule), and four gained dedicated playbook scenarios under design-restraint/, discharging rec 1's own not-yet-exercised caveat. Classification: ALREADY-ADOPTED (exceeded).

Rec 3 landed halfway: the native platform/runtime duplication row exists in the review checklist, but a distinct hand-rolled standard-library row was not located by the patterns searched. Classification: NEW (partially missing; states what was searched rather than asserting absence).

Rec 10's shrink row (same behavior, equally clear, fewer lines) is still absent from the review checklist and review-core, and its deferral now lives only in an archived packet with no owner; iteration 3's report-only lean-summary line covers the same information without a subjective per-finding row. Classification: LOST (pending).

Rec 11's code_loc plus over-engineering-marker metric was never folded into the Lane B sweep: the lane and its scorer still exist, but no code_loc or over-engineering metric appears in it, while Ponytail's loc.js supplies a working self-corrected measurement-only implementation. This is the clearest pending recommendation with both halves available. Classification: LOST (pending).

Rec 15's stated blocker is gone: session-lifecycle priming hooks now exist default-on and fail-open across Claude, Codex, Cursor, Devin and Pi with a shared implementation and thin adapters, but they inject spec-folder continuity context rather than a surface/standards payload, so the deferred work is now a payload addition to wired infrastructure. Classification: NEW.

The DO-NOT-ADOPT rejection of a standalone PromptFoo clone reasoned that it copies ponytail's missing correctness gate; Ponytail's agentic harness now has both a correctness gate and an adversarial safety tier, so that half of the rationale has aged out while the duplication objection stands, and the newly available gate-before-metric pattern is what rec 11's pending metric needs. Classification: NEW.

The archived negative-knowledge list is still honored, and iterations 3, 4 and 6 independently re-derived three of its conclusions from new evidence (no second review skill, no byte-equality or per-turn injection for skill surfaces, no ported task corpus). Classification: ALREADY-ADOPTED.

Rec 12 landed under a different name: agent mirror parity is enforced at commit time by a staged-only gate in the git pre-commit that calls check-agent-mirror-sync.cjs and blocks the commit, failing open with a warning only when node or the checker is unavailable. Classification: ALREADY-ADOPTED (relocated).
